title: Report a judge's catch rate per fault
statement: Score a judge on labelled cases per kind of fault, counting misses and false alarms against a baseline that always gives the majority verdict, with its bar from human agreement.
example: In a 100-item regression set with 1 faulty item among its 77 reading items, a judge that passed every reading item would still clear a 0.98 bar.
detail: The evaluator's 100-item regression set is labelled 88 ACCEPTABLE, 2 SUPERIOR and 10 INFERIOR; 77 are reading and language items, of which 1 is INFERIOR, and 9 of the 10 INFERIOR items are math. The runner folds ACCEPTABLE and SUPERIOR into one pass category and reports a single pass rate with no breakdown by label or subject, against a bar of 0.95 in the dataset and 0.98 by default in the runner. A judge that passed every reading item would miss 1 of 100 and still clear both bars (counted from the dataset). Calibrate the judge on a labelled set that holds known failures of each kind, report each rate over its own denominator, and add a chance-corrected agreement figure.
